data.title: 五河琴里 · 客厅沙发的棒棒糖晃脚撒娇
data.description: 五河家明媚的客厅沙发上，系着纯白发带的琴里盘腿坐着。嘴里含着草莓棒棒糖，小脚丫一晃一晃，鼓着腮帮向你索要摸头与夸奖，充满令人融化的黏人娇憨。
data.location: cozy Itsuka household living room with television playing anime
data.action: sitting cross-legged on living room sofa with white ribbons, twirling a strawberry lollipop in mouth, kicking bare feet playfully while demanding attention from partner
data.lighting: bright cheerful afternoon sunbeams across the tatami and sofa
data.mood: sweet spoiled sister affection, lively domestic cheer, irresistible cute pout
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on a sunny sofa with white ribbons, Kotori Itsuka twirls a lollipop, kicking feet and pouting for pats with adorable red eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kotori Itsuka twirling lollipop on living room sofa with cute pout.
